0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_001
0.description: Go and speak with Gerolt. I think you'll like what he has to offer!

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_005
1.description: I see you have your magia board. Good, very good. But you really ought to go and try configuring it with the magia melder first. I'll be here.

2.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_010
2.description: While taking preliminary readings, something unusual came to light.

3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_011
3.description: The headquarters of the Students of Baldesion was situated in a tower...which appears to be encased in a magical barrier. Someone or something seems to have activated our defenses.

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_012
4.description: I can only hope this was the work of survivors. The very possibility is enough to make investigating the tower a priority.

5.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_013
5.description: The question is, how are we to get there... Barriers notwithstanding, traveling on foot would place us at the mercy of the wilderness. 'Twould be safer to make use of the island's Aethernet.

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_014
6.description: Unfortunately, it doesn't appear to be in the best of shape at the moment. I'm not entirely sure why, but perhaps we can find a way to put it in good working order.

7.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_015
7.description: So. I have two favors to ask of you. One: attune to every Aethernet shard you find. Any difficulties you experience may help me to get to the root of the problem, and if you can use them without issue, then all the better.

8.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_016
8.description: Two: if you should come across a protean crystal, I want you to bring it to me.

9.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_017
9.description: I make this request on behalf of our financiers, to be clear. Which isn't to say that we shouldn't oblige them; we should. They have been quite generous with their support, after all.

10.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_018
10.description: I am sure you have heard this too many times before, but be careful. These creatures are unlike anything I have ever seen. Do not underestimate them.

11.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_019
11.description: And remember to attune to every Aethernet shard you find! Starting with that one over there if you haven't!

12.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_100_019
12.description: There will be times during your expedition in Eureka when you will receive no guidance from the duty list or the map. Speak with other players and share information to discover how to proceed!

13.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_20
13.description: You may now purchase items only available for use in the Forbidden Land, Eureka, from the expedition provisioner.

14.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_030
14.description: Don't forget about that protean crystal! The last thing you want to be is in debt to Hancock and Rowena!

15.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_035
15.description: Went beyond the walls, did you? Find any protean crystals?

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_036
16.description: Yes, this should suffice for our purposes...<hex:02100103>So tell me─have you gotten used to fighting the denizens of this island?

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_A1_000_002
19.description: If you ask me, it's needlessly complicated.

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_037
20.description: Haha! I should have expected nothing less from the Warrior of Light!

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_038
21.description: Well, I can't argue with that. But it is what it is, so you may as well get used to it, because I don't think all these dangerous beasts are going anywhere any time soon...

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_039
22.description: In trying to discern the reason for the Aethernet's failure, I discovered what can best be described as a “disruption” in the natural flow of the Lifestream in this region.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_040
23.description: I've yet to ascertain the cause of this disruption, but I believe you may be able to help me do so by conducting field investigations...in areas which I have yet to determine. But as soon as I do, I will tell you.

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_041
24.description: Right─let me hand this crystal back to you. Change of plans─you're to give it over to Gerolt. He needs it to do what he does best...

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_042
25.description: Level 70 antiquated gear and weapons may be enhanced by Gerolt should you possess sufficient protean crystals.

26.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_100_042
26.description: Lockboxes obtained in the Forbidden Land, Eureka, can be opened by expedition lockpicks in base camps or by R'ghonati in Kugane, and may yield a variety of items.

27.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_043
27.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 3.

28.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_050
28.description: Sorry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I am still studying the Aethernet and attempting to determine the cause of our problems...

29.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_051
29.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 3.

30.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_055
30.description: Good news, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I believe I have discerned the reason why we are having trouble utilizing the island's Aethernet.

31.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_056
31.description: Truth be told, it's caused me to reconsider some of the accepted truths of aetherology...but I have detected a confluence of aether, which would suggest a “blockage” of sorts...

32.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_057
32.description: I still don't know how or why this blockage might have formed─and this is where you come in. I want you to investigate the site of the blockage.

33.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_058
33.description: I can't provide you with the exact location, but I can tell you it is somewhere to the northwest. If I recall correctly, there was an observatory on a hill out that way─perhaps you might start there?

34.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_060
34.description: I wish I could tell you exactly where to go, but I can't. All I can say with certainty is that the blockage is somewhere to the northwest, near that observatory─or where it used to stand. I haven't ventured that far out since we returned...

35.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_070
35.description: Welcome back! Were you able to track down that confluence of aether?

36.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_071
36.description: Magicite, you say? Hmm... I wouldn't have thought it the source of the blockage, but while you were away, we confirmed the dissipation of the confluence. Your removal of the magicite would appear to explain that.

37.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_072
37.description: So magicite can impede the flow of the Lifestream itself. Fascinating...

38.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_073
38.description: Anyway, you may as well keep it for use with your magia board.

39.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_074
39.description: Owing to your actions, I'd say we've made progress towards restoring the Aethernet. We've still got a ways to go, though.

40.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_075
40.description: I'll continue my studies and let you know if I learn anything new. For now, I would encourage you to continue exploring Anemos on your own.

41.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_076
41.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 5.

42.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_080
42.description: I hope all is well with you. As for me and my research, I have nothing new to report. But when I do, you'll be the first to know.

43.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_081
43.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 5.

44.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_085
44.description: Looks like we've found another blockage, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If you're willing, I'd like to ask you to go and take a look for me again.

45.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_086
45.description: I knew I could count on you. Our readings place this one somewhere in the northeast, in an area we called the Orchard.

46.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_087
46.description: While the island is quite a bit different from what I remember, I'm reasonably certain you won't have to go so far as the river. Good luck out there!

47.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_090
47.description: Like I said, the confluence of aether we've detected appears to be somewhere to the northeast, but not so far as the river. It's still a fairly large area you'll need to search, but I know you're up to the task.

48.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_100
48.description: Don't tell me─you found another magicite at the heart of the confluence?

49.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_101
49.description: I thought as much. Like last time, we detected the dissipation while you were away, followed by a marked improvement in the flow of the aetherial currents.

50.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_103
50.description: Unfortunately, it wasn't enough to restore the Aethernet to good working order, I'm afraid. I can only surmise that there's more magicite out there, clogging the proverbial pipes.

51.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_104
51.description: But now that we know exactly what we're looking for, finding the next confluence should be even easier, I'd like to think. I'll keep you informed.

52.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_105
52.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 13.

53.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_110
53.description: No luck yet, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We're still searching for another confluence of aether. Rest assured that once we know where it is, you will too.

54.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_111
54.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 13.

55.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_115
55.description: Perfect timing, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We detected another confluence of aether just now. Another piece of magicite causing trouble, like as not. Are you available to go and investigate?

56.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_116
56.description: Wonderful! Assuming our measurements are accurate, this should be quite close to the Marge─the waterfall far to the north of here.

57.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_117
57.description: Assuming the area is as I remember, you should have a clear view of our former headquarters. Perhaps you will even be able to see the barrier encasing it...

58.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_120
58.description: The magicite should be somewhere fairly close to the Marge, far up north. Hopefully you won't have to search too long to find it.

59.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_130
59.description: No need to say it, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We already know you found the magicite. Our instruments told us the tale.

60.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_131
60.description: I must say, it's a good thing you agreed to join our expedition. If it weren't for you, I doubt my investigation would be proceeding so smoothly.

61.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_132
61.description: I want to believe we're almost there, but I cannot say anything with certainty, save that there is at least one more piece of magicite somewhere in Anemos, preventing us from utilizing the Aethernet...

62.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_133
62.description: Anyway, don't let me keep you. I'm sure you have better things to do than to watch me fiddle with aetherometers and the like. As usual, if we determine the location of another piece of magicite, I'll let you know.

63.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_134
63.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 17.

64.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_140
64.description: Let me guess: wondering if we found any more magicite? Sorry to disappoint you, but not yet. But it's still out there, somewhere...

65.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_141
65.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 17.

66.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_145
66.description: This is it, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The last piece of magicite in Anemos. The last obstacle to us restoring the Aethernet. I'm sure of it.

67.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_146
67.description: This one looks to be far, far to the northeast, beyond the Val River Swale...probably in Uncanny Valley.

68.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_147
68.description: It won't be easy, though. According to our measurements, that area has some of the highest concentrations of aether in this region. Any beasts that can endure that are like to be formidable opponents...

69.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_150
69.description: This last piece of magicite is somewhere on the other side of the Val River Swale, in Uncanny Valley, we think. Not only will you need to search a large area, but said area is home to some of the most dangerous creatures you'll face in Anemos. Be careful.

70.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_160
70.description: Good to see you again. Not that I ever doubted you would return, but it still feels good regardless.

71.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_100_160
71.description: As usual, we were able to confirm your removal of the magicite from here. Though I must say, it seemed as though you secured it rather more quickly than before. Did you make exceptionally good time or some such?

72.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_161
72.description: Ejika found it first!? That comes as a surprise... And what other method could he be considering to reach our headquarters...?

73.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_162
73.description: Well, there's no point in worrying over it. He has his ways, we have ours. Restoring the Aethernet remains our best way forward, I believe.

74.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_163
74.description: Speaking of which, we've almost finished! That piece of magicite you brought back does indeed appear to have been the last interfering with the natural flow of the Lifestream in this region.

75.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_164
75.description: It might not be enough to guarantee safe travel directly to our headquarters, but at the very least it might allow us to reach nearby regions...

76.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_165
76.description: Of course, there is still an inherent risk in teleporting to an unattuned beacon─one that may no longer exist, even. Death, albeit a painless one resulting from becoming lost in the Lifestream...

77.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_166
77.description: Fortunately, the Aethernet relays we have developed should mitigate that risk significantly. Assuming, that is, that the one here in Anemos is functioning properly─which is what I need you to confirm.

78.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_167
78.description: You will need to head northeast across the Val River Swale again. Look for a door leading inside the ridge to Aethernet Control. The relay won't be hard to find.

79.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_170
79.description: Aethernet Control is located inside the ridge separating the Val River Swale and the Anemos Seam. I'll contact you via linkpearl once you find it.

80.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_180
80.description: I know, I know. Procuring ninety-nine Anemos crystals is hardly the easiest task, but I truly believe this is the easiest and most reliable way of reintegrating that relay into the Aethernet.

81.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_181
81.description: So you know, this method is partially based on the selfsame one Moenbryda used to deliver you to Ysayle's sanctuary...

82.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_182
82.description: I never knew her myself... Moenbryda, I mean. I suppose I never met Ysayle either. I would have liked to have known them both, I think...

83.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_190
83.description: That name you heard, Galuf...that was my adopted grandfather's name. And from what you described, I do not think that is any coincidence.

84.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_191
84.description: Galuf Baldesion founded the Students, together with three of his fellow Archons.

85.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_192
85.description: If they were the men you saw in your vision, then the island they spoke of was almost certainly the Isle of Val. But this entity they spoke of “sealing away”─Grandfather told me nothing of such things.

86.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_193
86.description: I should like very much to ask him...but he was one of many missing and presumed dead when we believed the island destroyed. But we were wrong about that...and I can only hope we were wrong about him.

87.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_194
87.description: As for who that masked man could have been, I haven't the foggiest. He certainly didn't sound like anyone I have ever met...

88.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_195
88.description: Mysteries heaped upon mysteries. Still, it changes nothing. We must continue to seek out survivors, and survivors are most likely to be found inside our headquarters.

89.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_196
89.description: You've done everything I asked of you and more, but now it's my turn. Those adjustments I told you about─the ones I need to make to the Aethernet relay─are going to take time. Until I finish, you may consider our expedition on hold.

90.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_197
90.description: Thank you again for all your hard work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'll be in touch!

91.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_198
91.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition. The expedition will continue in a future update.

92.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_100_198
92.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition.

93.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_110_198
93.description: To continue the expedition, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane to travel to <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8022C03>.

94.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_199
94.description: You may now ride mounts within Eureka Anemos!

95.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_KRILE_000_200
95.description: I'm sure you're eager to resume the expedition, and so am I. Rest assured that those adjustments I spoke of are proceeding apace, and that I will contact you as soon as I have finished.

96.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_201
96.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition. The expedition will continue in a future update.

97.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_210
97.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition.

98.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTKRILE_00455_SYSTEM_000_211
98.description: To continue the expedition, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane to travel to <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8022C03>.
